content_blocks.text: The old lighthouse stood silent on the cliff's edge, its weathered stone walls whispering secrets of the past. The wind carried the scent of salt and seaweed, mingling with the distant cries of gulls. As the first light of dawn broke over the horizon, the keeper unlocked the door, his footsteps echoing through the narrow corridors. Each step seemed to carry him further back in time, into a world where the line between reality and legend blurred.
